criteria.reason: The workout exercise menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option.
Selecting it opens a confirmation modal before applying the skip.
The existing sets endpoint persists each submitted set with status “skipped”.
The card displays “Skipped” when all sets in the current workout are skipped.
The menu offers “Resume Exercise,” which clears skipped sets during the session.
The existing logger sets endpoint handles skip and unskip requests.
A server test covers persisting skipped status and removing skipped sets on resume.
No new client test for the skip UI appears in the diff.
The harness reports all existing tests pass: 198 server and 289 client.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
